summary: Juneteenth holiday session (US equity markets closed); SPCX stopped out at $174.90 (-13.3%) and INTC hit Target 1 at $133.99 (+10.2%) on the Apple-Intel 18A-P chip deal. closed_today.note: SPCX closed at $174.90 on June 18 — $5.10 below the $180 daily close stop.
